title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: amendment terms by category
content:
## What this card covers
This card sets out, for each acceptance category of the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the terms that bound an amended declaration: whether the declaration may be amended after approval, which particulars an amendment may change, the most signed amendments per acceptance, the largest change of declared gross weight, whether the container count may rise, and how many hours before the cargo cut-off an amendment is accepted at the latest.

## Terms by category
| Category | Amendable after approval | Particulars an amendment may change | Signed amendments per acceptance, at most | Largest gross-weight change (percent of the weight before the amendment) | Container count may rise | Amendment accepted until, hours before cargo cut-off |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | Yes | gross weight, container count | 3 | 10 | Yes | 24 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | Yes | UN number, proper shipping name, packing group, gross weight, container count | 3 | 10 | Yes | 48 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | Yes | UN number, proper shipping name, packing group, gross weight, container count | 2 | 10 | Yes | 48 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | Yes | proper shipping name, packing group, gross weight | 2 | 5 | No | 72 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | Yes | proper shipping name, gross weight | 2 | 5 | No | 72 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | No | gross weight | 1 | 2 | No | 120 |

## Points of judgement (read from the table)
- *Is the IMDG class on any category's list of amendable particulars?* No category lists it.
- *Is the gross weight amendable in every category?* Yes; it is the one particular on all six lists.
- *May an AHL DG Compressed Gases amendment raise the container count?* No; that column shows "No", and the container count is not on its list of particulars either.
- *Which category does not allow an amendment after approval?* AHL DG Special Approval.
- *Under AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers, may an amendment change the UN number?* No; its list is proper shipping name, packing group and gross weight.
